ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: libvorbis (Xiph.Org): the Ogg Vorbis audio decoder and encoder
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: libvorbis, libvorbisfile and libvorbisenc of libvorbis 1.3.7 in one module, as listed in lib/Makefile.am, with the codebooks and encoder modes (lib/books, lib/modes). The encoder sources are only linked into a product when libvorbisenc is referenced. The analysis tools (barkmel, tone, psytune), the vq tools, the examples and the tests are not part of the module.
